item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 01 September 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaDelNorte(LeonB.Postigo, Sindangan, Labason, Kalawit, Sirawai, Gutalac, Baliguian, Siocon), #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan, Titay, Ipil, Naga, Tungawan and RosellerLim) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #ZamboangaDelNorte(Liloy, Tampilisan, Salug and Godod) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
